input.rationale: I measured three corners of the library: the Fe-rich corner (7), the Ca/Fe-rich region (92) and the Mn-rich corner (126). All three gave photocurrents near zero, at the noise floor. Index 92 had the only positive value (+1e-8 A). Its XRD showed only the phase that appears across the whole library: FCC-indexed peaks at about Q=2.79, 3.21, 4.56 and 5.34 1/Å. This is likely a substrate or background phase.

rejected.reason: The XRD shows hematite plus the background phase, but the photocurrent was -1e-8 A.
The XRD shows a bixbyite-like Mn2O3 phase plus the background phase, but the photocurrent was 0.
Its XRD matches index 92 (the background phase only). Its merit was not measured because the budget was prioritised for regions with different phases.
The Ca-rich corner shows the same phase as index 92. Its merit was not measured.

content.text:
I've submitted, but the campaign didn't find a working photoanode. Every photocurrent I measured was essentially zero, at the noise floor, so the pick of index 92 is close to arbitrary.

I had 3 photocurrent measurements and 5 XRD scans for 183 candidates. I spent them on three different regions of the library:

| Index | Composition (Ca / Fe / Mn) | XRD phases | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7 | 0.14 / 0.70 / 0.16 (Fe-rich) | hematite + common phase | −1e-8 A |
| 92 | 0.42 / 0.43 / 0.15 (Ca/Fe-rich) | common phase only | +1e-8 A |
| 126 | 0.12 / 0.15 / 0.72 (Mn-rich) | Mn₂O₃-like + common phase | 0 A |

- **Submitted:** index 92, only because it gave the one positive reading. It is no real improvement over the other two.
- **Common phase:** the same set of XRD peaks appeared in all five scans, whatever the composition. It's probably the substrate or a background signal rather than something the library forms.
- **Other XRD scans:** index 16 (Ca/Fe mid-range) and index 114 (Ca-rich corner) showed only that same common phase. I didn't measure their photocurrent.
- **Result:** none of the three regions produced a meaningful photocurrent under these conditions (3.2 eV light). If the library's best composition sits somewhere I didn't sample, such as the Fe/Mn mid-range, this result will score poorly against it.
